body:
@DzmitryShylovich updated.

And I found this pb when fixing another issue, and have fixed it in PR #15651.

> The router checks the CanDeactivate() and CanActivateChild() guards first, from the deepest child route to the top.

looks like an error about `CanActivateChild`. The router checks `CanActivate` first and from the top to bottom http://plnkr.co/edit/NxLmkAq1zTpWHjgH6S4C?p=preview

_I could remove other guards to demo this issue only, my fault._

In the example, if navigate from `/root/branch/1` to `/root/branch/2/leaf` (reusing route nodes), the deactivate guard runs in **top to bottom** (wrong) order:
```
DEACTIVATE: root
DEACTIVATE: branch
DEACTIVATE: leaf
```

if nav from `/root/branch/2/leaf` to `/whatever`, the guard order is **bottom to top** (as expected):
```
DEACTIVATE: leaf
DEACTIVATE: branch
DEACTIVATE: root
```

@royling correct. it's a `CanDeactivate` bug.
I'm talking about incorrect `CanActivateChild` description in the documentation.
@royling could you please create a new pr for this bug only (1 issue - 1 pr) with a test  without can activate guards, so it will be more clear and easier to review?

issue.title: fix(router): canDeactivate guards should run from bottom to top
